items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: The interviewee only responds to the interviewer's statement about Baby Dodds with 'Yeah, well, it had some tunes in the back that he liked, I think.' There is no indication of a personal relationship, meeting, or collaboration between Jerry Blumberg and Baby Dodds.

ctx.x: I don't recall. It was published by the Church Company, the John Church Company. That's Philadelphia, I think.

And, uh... I think there maybe had been two series of Imperial Methods. I found some real old Imperial Violin and Mandolin Methods once. It might have been an older series. And Baby Dodds, if I remember rightly, had an Imperial Drum Method. Oh, is it right? He kept it for all those years. He was, he almost cried when he thought about it. He left it in the car once and took his car in for repair and somebody stole it. After keeping it ever since he was a kid here in New Orleans, took it to New York and the thing…
Yeah, well, it had some tunes in the back that he liked, I think. There's one, uh... I don't know if I can even remember the name. It's, it's, uh... I think it's a quadrille or something in the back.
